result.instructions: Tools for OfficeRnD, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes OfficeRnD data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run officernd_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run officernd_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run officernd_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. officernd_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: officernd_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: Fetch the OfficeRnD organization these credentials belong to — name, slug and region. A cheap way to confirm the setup works. OfficeRnD: GET /api/v2/organizations/{orgSlug}.

tools.name: officernd_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the organization's locations (coworking spaces/buildings) with address, timezone and open/public flags. Location _ids are needed by most other filters and by officernd_create_member. OfficeRnD: GET /locations.

is_public.description: Only locations shown (true) or hidden (false) in the members portal.

cursor_next.description: The cursorNext from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

cursor_prev.description: The cursorPrev from a page, to go one page back.

tools.name: officernd_create_member
tools.title: Create a member
tools.description: WRITE. Add a new member (person) to a location, optionally attached to a company. Needs scope flex.community.members.create. OfficeRnD: POST /members.

location.description: The _id of the member's location (see officernd_list_locations).

company.description: The _id of the company the member belongs to.

is_billing_person.description: Whether the member receives the company's invoices.

is_contact_person.description: Whether the member is a contact person of the company.

properties.description: Custom properties, keyed by property name.

tools.name: officernd_update_member
tools.title: Update a member
tools.description: WRITE. Update a member's name, email, phone, start date, billing/contact flags, tags or custom properties. Only the fields you pass are changed; `tags` replaces the whole tag list. Needs scope flex.community.members.update. OfficeRnD: PUT /members/{memberId}.

is_billing_person.description: Whether the member receives the company's invoices.

is_contact_person.description: Whether the member is a contact person of the company.

tags.description: Replaces the member's entire tag list.

tools.name: officernd_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: WRITE. Book a resource (e.g. a meeting room) for a member and/or company. Unless is_free or is_tentative is set, the booking is charged per the resource's rate, and the member is notified unless is_silent. Needs scope flex.space.bookings.create. OfficeRnD: POST /bookings.

resource.description: The _id of the resource to book (see officernd_list_resources).

member.description: The _id of the member the booking is for.

company.description: The _id of the company the booking is for.

is_free.description: Mark as free — no fees are generated.

is_silent.description: If true, no notification is sent to the member.

enforce_booking_policy.description: If true, apply member validations (business hours, durations, limits) and booking-policy approval flagging.

tools.name: officernd_create_ticket
tools.title: Open a helpdesk ticket
tools.description: WRITE. Open a helpdesk ticket on behalf of a member. type, priority and severity are ticket-option _ids from officernd_list_ticket_options. Needs scope flex.collaboration.tickets.create. OfficeRnD: POST /tickets.

member.description: The _id of the member raising the ticket.

tools.name: officernd_add_ticket_comment
tools.title: Comment on a ticket
tools.description: WRITE. Post a comment on a helpdesk ticket. Public comments are visible to the member; comments attributed to members must be public. Needs scope flex.collaboration.ticketComments.create. OfficeRnD: POST /ticket-comments/{ticketId}.

member.description: The _id of the member the comment is posted as.

is_public.description: Whether the comment is public (visible to the member).
